title: dedicated-autoscaler: improve burst controls and utilization reporting (v19)
author: Anika Patel
description: Context and motivation: Customers running Redwood Dedicated have asked for clearer, more actionable burst controls and better utilization reporting to diagnose throttle events and capacity shortfalls. This PR consolidates previous v17/v18 work and addresses field feedback: 1) surfaces per-fleet burst budget and bucket refill metrics, 2) adds a new 'burst_reserve' config that guarantees short-term throughput during autoscaler ramp-downs, 3) improves fleet_utilization reporting to include request latency percentiles and request-class breakdowns. Summary of changes: updated autoscaler controller to track burst buckets with leaky-bucket algorithm, added controller-level metrics and Prometheus scrape targets, extended the dedicated API to expose per-fleet burst and utilization endpoints (internal API only), and added e2e tests for degradation + recovery scenarios. Notes: this is backward-compatible for existing configs; new 'burst_reserve' defaults to 0 (opt-in). Linked tickets: ENG-4821 (burst SLA), ENG-4850 (utilization dashboard items).
commit_summary: 3 commits: 1) controller: implement burst bucket accounting and refill logic; 2) api: add /fleet/{id}/burst and /fleet/{id}/utilization endpoints + auth checks; 3) tests: add e2e and unit tests for burst behavior and reporting
patch_snippets: +// new: refill logic uses token refill rate based on fleet_capacity * refill_ratio

Author (Anika): Added e2e test 'burst_recovery_test.go' that simulates rapid scale down and verifies burst_reserve keeps p95 latency under SLA.
Marta Lopez (reviewer): Metrics look good, but can we avoid high-cardinality labels on fleet metrics? Suggest moving 'route' tag to a histogram label instead.
Author: Removed route label from per-token metrics and added aggregated route histogram as suggested. See telemetry changes in prometheus.yaml.
Sasha Ivanov (approver): Verified workloads against internal staging, observed improved p99 tail under burst scenario. Approved with minor nits fixed.

changelog_entry:
- controllers: track per-fleet burst buckets and refill logic
- api: new internal endpoints: /fleet/{id}/burst, /fleet/{id}/utilization
- metrics: new Prometheus metrics for burst_budget, burst_refill_rate, fleet_utilization_p95
testing_notes: Added e2e test 'burst_recovery_test.go' which runs in CI. Manual staging run with synthetic load shows sustained throughput during rapid downscale when burst_reserve > 0.
migration_notes: Operators: to opt into burst reserve, set dedicated.autoscaler.burstReserve in Helm values (defaults to 0). No in-place data migration required.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: core autoscaler logic modified; covered by unit and e2e tests. Rolling deploy recommended; feature gated by config flag (burst_reserve).
notes: Follow-up work: ENG-4902 (dashboard tile for burst budget history) and ENG-4920 (expose burst metrics in Redwood Console).
